regions.today: Dry for most today with a mix of cloud and some bright or sunny spells, though there may be a few light showers also. Highest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees with moderate easterly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with a mix of cloud, clear spells and a few light showers. Lowest temperatures of 1 to 6 degrees generally, though milder near coasts. Easterly winds will be mostly light, reaching moderate and occasionally fresh near coasts.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be another dry day for most with a mix of cloud, sunshine and just a few light showers. Moderate east to northeast winds will ease mostly light later in the day, with highest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees.
